metadata.note: The Boston, Hartford and Erie Railroad (chartered 1863; receivership 1870) and its successor the New York and New England Railroad (chartered 17 Apr 1873, in possession of the system 1875/1877; reorganized as the New England Railroad 26 Aug 1895; leased to the New York, New Haven and Hartford from 1 Jul 1898). This layer draws only the two companies' own operating eras, 1863-1898: the Boston main line to Willimantic, the Hartford, Providence & Fishkill line Providence - Hartford - Waterbury and its western extension to Danbury, Brewster and Fishkill Landing, the Woonsocket Division, the Southbridge, Rockville, Valley Falls, Dedham, Milford/Hopkinton, Hartford - Springfield, Melrose - Rockville, Waterbury - Cromwell, Woonsocket - Harrisville and Providence & Springfield lines, the Norwich & Worcester as lessee, the BH&E's South Manchester lease and its brief 1869-1870 Dutchess & Columbia lease in New York. Research report: research/branches/new_york_and_new_england_railroad.txt.
metadata.operator_split: Rule 4: every line the BH&E ran is split into a 'Boston, Hartford and Erie' feature and a 'New York and New England' feature sharing identical geometry, at 1875 for the Boston lines (NY&NE possession 'sometime in 1875', Wikipedia NYNE) and 1877 for the ex-HP&F lines (Harlow via NYNE). Both boundaries are LOW confidence: 1870-1875/77 were BH&E receivership years, drawn in BH&E colour. The 26 Aug 1895 reorganization into the New England Railroad is NOT a split - same company, same trains; the New Haven's stock control from 1895 does not change who ran the trains. Every feature ends at the New Haven lease, 1 Jul 1898 (or earlier where the line was lost or closed).

Pascoag - Douglas Junction: 1893 [ANCHOR], the opening year only; no positive passenger evidence and the closure year (c.1896-97) is not established.

Providence & Springfield lease: 1890 (PS) vs 1 Jul 1896 (NYNE) - drawn from 1896.
Milford & Woonsocket / MF&P / Hopkinton lease: Sept 1887 (MS) vs 1 Apr 1897 (NYNE) - drawn from 1897.
Norwich & Worcester lease history: cancelled and re-leased 1884 (NW) vs renewed 1886 (NYNE); no source shows independent N&W operation after 1869.
Waterbury - Danbury exact opening month in 1881.
New England Limited 18 Nov 1884 start (rootsweb page seen only as a search snippet).
